# Net Forge card battler template (INKWRIT)

> A one-against-one card battler. Two scribes duel at a desk: heroes with
> health, ink (mana) that rises each turn, a hand drawn from a shuffled
> deck, inked creatures on the board, spells. A run is a gauntlet of
> duels; after each one, every player drafts one of three cards into
> their deck. Alone, an AI scribe of the gauntlet takes the other seat.
> You change the game by editing src/game.ts only. The template already has
> the duel, turns and the turn timer, the shuffle (on the server), hidden
> hands, guards, rush, the draft, the AI, netcode, rendering, touch,
> earn and the store. Do not write renderers, netcode or AI.

## Files

- src/game.ts: THE GAME. Declarations against @netforge/engine:
  game(), cardTable(), card(), upgrade(), earn.rule(), earn.stake(), store.sku().
- src/names.json: the title and every label players read. Cards go in
  "weapons" ({ name, line }), plus upgrades, earn rules and store items.
- Everything else is template machinery.

## Rules the build enforces

- game({ template: "cards", style, places, players: { prefab, max } }), players.max at most 2.
- Exactly one cardTable(...); 4 to 40 card(...)s. The starter deck (8 to 30
  cards) names declared cards, holds at least one unit and cards costing 2
  or less. ai is 1 to 12 tiers { health, smart }.
- A unit has health 1 or more; a spell has an effect.
- Effects: kind "damage", "heal", "draw" or "buff"; target "enemy" (the
  player picks an enemy unit or the hero), "enemy_hero", "all_enemies",
  "own_hero", "own_unit" (the player picks one of theirs) or "all_own".
- Upgrades read four stats only: maxHealth (hero health), might (+attack on
  the buyer's units), haste (+ink in the first turn), amount (+cards in
  the first hand).
- No weapon(...). Asset ids look like "style.lowpoly.frog"; keep game({ style }).
- 2 playtest players must decide duels and fire an earn rule within 4 minutes.

## Units

Health and attack in points, cost in ink (0 to 10), seconds for timers.
Tick rate 30 Hz.

## The loop

A duel: a coin decides who goes first; the second player draws one extra
card. Each turn: +1 ink (up to manaMax), draw a card (an empty deck hurts
more each time), play cards, attack with ready units (a unit is ready the
turn after it lands, or at once with rush; guard units must be attacked
first), end the turn (or the timer ends it). A hero at 0 loses; turnCap
turns is a draw. After each duel but the last, a draft: one of three.

## Common changes

### A new card
card("mirror_moth", { model: "style.lowpoly.jelly_flyer", kind: "unit", cost: 3, attack: 2, health: 2, effect: { kind: "damage", amount: 1, target: "all_enemies" } });
Add its label to names.json weapons. The draft offers every card unless cardTable pool lists some.

### Tune the table
cardTable({ health: 25, duels: 5, turnSeconds: 40, ... }). Lower health
makes faster duels; more duels make longer runs.

### Harder or easier AI
ai: [{ health: 14, smart: 0.3 }, ...]: duel n against the AI uses tier n;
raise health and smart for a harder gauntlet.

### Earn rules
earn.rule("ink_master", { when: "ai.beaten", n: 3, pay: 15, oncePer: "run" });
Events: duel.won (a duel won against a person; never against the AI, never
a forfeit), ai.beaten (a gauntlet AI scribe beaten; a forfeit pays
nothing), run.won (more duels won than lost in the run). Each rule pays
once per run per player, in coins; the room server is the referee; the AI
scribe never earns.

### The buy-in run (required)
earn.stake({ min: 10, max: 100, multiple: 2 }); one top-level line. "stake" is reserved.

### Coins: earn and the store
store.sku("thick_vellum", { coins: 40 });                            // one level of the upgrade for the run
store.sku("skin_gold_leaf", { coins: 500, grants: { cosmetic: 2 } }); // a finish for your quill, owned for good
store.sku("bound_folio", { coins: 120, grants: { gear: "thick_vellum", loseBelow: 0.25 } }); // losable gear
Keep the SKUs the client is wired to (thick_vellum, sharp_nib, quick_ink,
spare_page, skin_vermilion, skin_gold_leaf, bound_folio) at their prices.

## Hidden information

Decks are shuffled on the room server and their order never leaves it; a
hand and a draft offer are sent only to their owner. Nothing in game.ts
can change that.

## Test

engine.test.run({ ticks: 30 * 240, bots: 2 }) plays duels between two
players (bots: 1 plays one person against the AI) and reports duels won
(kills) and lost (deaths), the duel reached (wave), runs, earned by rule,
softlock, ms per tick and the genre's checks under rules.checks.

## Worked example: src/game.ts

This is the template's complete src/game.ts as it ships. A new game on this
template starts from this file and changes declarations in place.

```ts
/**
 * INKWRIT: the card battler template (play style:
 * card battler).
 *
 * Scribes duel in a lamplit study. Every card is an inked creature or a
 * spell written on a page: blot imps, ledger crabs, folio wyrms, a splash
 * of ink. One against one, a person against a person or against the
 * gauntlet's AI scribes. A run is four duels; after each, you draft one of
 * three new cards into your deck.
 *
 * This file is the whole game as the model writes it: declarations only,
 * against the typed API in @netforge/engine. The duel, the draft, the
 * shuffle, hidden hands, the AI, netcode, renderer and referee are the
 * template's machinery.
 */
import { card, cardTable, earn, game, store, upgrade } from "@netforge/engine";

export default game({
  template: "cards",
  style: "lowpoly",
  places: { study: { chunks: "places/study", spawn: [0, 0, 0] } },
  players: { prefab: "style.lowpoly.hooded_adventurer", max: 2 },
});

// The table: hero health, hands, the board, the gauntlet and its AI scribes (tier n plays duel n against the AI).
cardTable({
  health: 20,
  startHand: 3,
  handMax: 7,
  boardMax: 5,
  manaMax: 10,
  turnSeconds: 30,
  draftSeconds: 15,
  duels: 4,
  starter: ["blot_imp", "blot_imp", "quill_sprite", "quill_sprite", "ink_frog", "ink_frog", "margin_bat", "ledger_crab", "serif_fox", "splash", "splash", "blotting_sand"],
  ai: [
    { health: 14, smart: 0.3 },
    { health: 16, smart: 0.55 },
    { health: 20, smart: 0.75 },
    { health: 24, smart: 0.9 },
  ],
});

// Units: cost in mana, attack and health. guard units must be attacked first; rush units attack the turn they land.
card("blot_imp", { model: "style.lowpoly.imp", kind: "unit", cost: 1, attack: 2, health: 1 });
card("quill_sprite", { model: "style.lowpoly.bee", kind: "unit", cost: 1, attack: 1, health: 2, rush: true });
card("ink_frog", { model: "style.lowpoly.frog", kind: "unit", cost: 2, attack: 2, health: 3 });
card("margin_bat", { model: "style.lowpoly.bat", kind: "unit", cost: 2, attack: 3, health: 1, rush: true });
card("ledger_crab", { model: "style.lowpoly.crab", kind: "unit", cost: 3, attack: 2, health: 5, guard: true });
card("serif_fox", { model: "style.lowpoly.fox", kind: "unit", cost: 3, attack: 3, health: 3, effect: { kind: "draw", amount: 1 } });
card("gloss_wolf", { model: "style.lowpoly.wolf", kind: "unit", cost: 4, attack: 4, health: 4 });
card("stamp_golem", { model: "style.lowpoly.yeti", kind: "unit", cost: 5, attack: 4, health: 7, guard: true });
card("folio_wyrm", { model: "style.lowpoly.dragon_whelp", kind: "unit", cost: 6, attack: 5, health: 5, effect: { kind: "damage", amount: 2, target: "all_enemies" } });
card("grand_errata", { model: "style.lowpoly.dragon", kind: "unit", cost: 8, attack: 8, health: 8 });
// Spells: an effect only. "enemy" lets the player pick an enemy unit or the hero.
card("splash", { model: "style.lowpoly.crystal", kind: "spell", cost: 1, effect: { kind: "damage", amount: 2, target: "enemy" } });
card("blotting_sand", { model: "style.lowpoly.gem_mid", kind: "spell", cost: 2, effect: { kind: "heal", amount: 5, target: "own_hero" } });
card("underline", { model: "style.lowpoly.gem_pink", kind: "spell", cost: 2, effect: { kind: "buff", amount: 2, target: "own_unit" } });
card("second_draft", { model: "style.lowpoly.chest", kind: "spell", cost: 3, effect: { kind: "draw", amount: 2 } });
card("ink_storm", { model: "style.lowpoly.meteor", kind: "spell", cost: 4, effect: { kind: "damage", amount: 2, target: "all_enemies" } });
card("final_word", { model: "style.lowpoly.crystal_rock", kind: "spell", cost: 5, effect: { kind: "damage", amount: 5, target: "enemy" } });

// Store upgrades: one level each, for the rest of the run (hero health, unit attack, first-turn mana, starting hand).
upgrade("thick_vellum", { stat: "maxHealth", step: 5, maxLevel: 1 });
upgrade("sharp_nib", { stat: "might", step: 1, maxLevel: 1 });
upgrade("quick_ink", { stat: "haste", step: 1, maxLevel: 1 });
upgrade("spare_page", { stat: "amount", step: 1, maxLevel: 1 });

// Earn (mandatory). Pays the game's coins (1 coin = 1 token), once per run each. Values are PLACEHOLDER.
// duel.won counts duels won against a person (never against the AI, never a forfeit); ai.beaten counts gauntlet AI scribes beaten.
earn.rule("first_ink", { when: "ai.beaten", n: 1, pay: 5, oncePer: "run" });
earn.rule("full_gauntlet", { when: "ai.beaten", n: 4, pay: 20, oncePer: "run" });
earn.rule("inked_duel", { when: "duel.won", n: 1, pay: 12, oncePer: "run" });
earn.rule("signed_and_sealed", { when: "duel.won", n: 3, pay: 25, oncePer: "run" });
// Buy-in run (the mandatory sink loop): stake coins at run start to earn above free play. Values are PLACEHOLDER.
earn.stake({ min: 10, max: 100, multiple: 2 });

// Store (the Kit), priced in coins: four run upgrades and two finishes for your quill, owned for good.
store.sku("thick_vellum", { coins: 40 });
store.sku("sharp_nib", { coins: 60 });
store.sku("quick_ink", { coins: 40 });
store.sku("spare_page", { coins: 50 });
store.sku("skin_vermilion", { coins: 300, grants: { cosmetic: 1 } });
store.sku("skin_gold_leaf", { coins: 500, grants: { cosmetic: 2 } });
// Losable gear: one level of its upgrade in every staked run, lost when that run makes under loseBelow of its most earn. PLACEHOLDER.
store.sku("bound_folio", { coins: 120, grants: { gear: "thick_vellum", loseBelow: 0.25 } });
```

## Validate and playtest

### With the MCP server

Run `npx -y @netforge/mcp` (package @netforge/mcp, bin netforge-mcp) and
connect it to your coding agent. Its tools are netforge_list_templates, netforge_create_game,
netforge_explain_api, netforge_search_docs, netforge_validate_game, netforge_run_playtest and netforge_play_locally.

- netforge_validate_game checks src/game.ts against the engine's schemas and this
  template's rules, and returns one actionable line per problem.
- netforge_run_playtest plays the game headless with bots and returns the report.
- netforge_play_locally gives the steps to open the game in a browser with kit play.

### In code

Import the game module first so its declarations register, then run the
headless harness. This plays two players for 4 minutes at 30 Hz (bots: 1 plays one person against the AI).

```ts
import { engine } from "@netforge/engine";
import "./src/game.js";

const report = await engine.test.run({
  ticks: 30 * 240,
  bots: 2,
  seed: 1,
  assert: [
    { name: "earn fired", check: (r) => r.earnEmitted > 0 },
    { name: "no softlock", check: (r) => !r.softlock },
  ],
});
if (report.failed.length > 0) throw new Error(report.failed.join("\n"));
```

The report has duels won (kills) and lost (deaths), the duel reached (wave), runs, earned by rule, softlock, ms per tick and the genre's checks under rules.checks.

The template's own tests (vitest) are the reference checks:

- test/harness.test.ts
- test/store.test.ts

### Play it locally

In a folder with netnet.json and src/game.ts:

```sh
npm install @netforge/kit-play @netforge/engine @netforge/template-cards
echo '{"template":"cards"}' > netnet.json
npx kit-play        # opens http://127.0.0.1:4663
```

kit play builds the template client with your src/game.ts and runs a local
room host with play money. No wallet, no chain and no hosted servers are
involved. Open the link in more tabs for more players.
